Etymology tree
Old Chinese 秦 (*zin)der.?
Sanskrit चीन (cīna)der.
Middle Persian 𐭰𐭩𐭭 (cyn /⁠čīn⁠/)der.
Arabic الصين
From Middle Persian 𐭰𐭩𐭭 (cyn /⁠čīn⁠/, “China”), from Sanskrit चीन (cīna, “China”), itself usually derived from Old Chinese 秦 (*zin, “Qin”). It is one of the Arabic country names which require the definite article ال (al-). See “Names of China” at Wikipedia.
